correctness.rationale: The tangent expansion has fourth-order coefficient one and yields explicit E2 and E3 conditions at all nontrivial affine points. A factored Sylvester resultant, a linear subresultant with a coefficient invertible at every exceptional root, and integer substitution divisibility establish existence and uniqueness of the contact variable. Smooth boundary points are excluded and the permanent infinity hyperflex is counted. The discriminant and the characteristic-eleven direct reduction establish exactly four or two exceptional geometric parameters. The two included exact symbolic and finite-characteristic programs successfully replayed the critical identities and modular cases.

value.rationale: A hyperflex is an intrinsically motivated genus-three Weierstrass degeneracy, and the family is a natural one-dimensional moduli stratum with cyclic-six automorphisms. A complete geometric hyperflex classification over all primes >=5, a prime-11 component-degree collapse, and symmetry/Frobenius/isomorphism structure supply a natural exact invariant and a sharply localized arithmetic exception rather than a routine count.
